text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The sweets trending on social 
media are seriously recommended!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I went out with Cesario and ate some! It 
was soooo delicious.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Once I took a bite, I just couldn't stop! 
I didn't even notice the cream on my 
cheek. And then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario wiped it off with her 
handkerchief. ...Ehehe!

It looks like Rhein Kraft had a very 
fulfilling day off!
